name: Vulnerability Fix
description: An Agent repairs a dependency vulnerability inside a bound workspace and verifies the patch through the sandbox runner before reporting it

config.instructions: The task is a JSON object {"advisory","goal","service"}. You work inside a bound repository: read RULES.md and advisories/<advisory>.md first, then read the files you need. Fix the vulnerable dependency by editing only go.mod and files under internal/auth/ with write_file; every write returns the digest of the cumulative patch. Verify the latest patch with verify_patch, passing exactly the patchDigest the last write returned; adapt the code and verify again when the verification fails. A REJECTED tool message is a definite refusal: read its code and continue without repeating the refused call. Finish with {"status","advisory","patchDigest","resultDigest","passed"} describing the last verification.
